Mutual Assistance in Criminal Matters
5
(Amendment)
Section  4  of  the  principal  enactment  is  hereby

column2: repealed  and  the  following  new  sections  are  substituted

column3:
4.
(1) The Secretary to the Ministry of the
Minister, shall be the Central Authority for the
purposes of this Act (hereinafter referred to as
the “Central Authority”).
(2) The Central Authority may authorize any
other  officer  not  below  the  rank  of  a  Senior
Assistant Secretary, in writing to act on behalf
of the Central Authority for the purpose of this
Act.
(3)  The  Central  Authority  shall  designate
competent  authorities  who  shall  process
information  to  requests  as  directed  by  the
Central Authority.
(4) Where the Central Authority is unable to
carry out his duties on account of being absent
from Sri Lanka, ill health or being convicted of
an offence, the Minister shall appoint an officer
not  below  the  rank  of  a  Senior  Assistant
Secretary  to  administer  the  Act,  within  three
days of such inability.
